The '''Soaring Dactillions''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]].<ref name="Zal" /> The unit shares its name with the aerial [[Dactillion/Legends|Dactillions]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].<ref name="Visual">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] defector [[Zal Artha]] was assigned to the squadron and within [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] was flying [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat operations]].<ref name="Zal" /> Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> following an attrition [[Raid on the Fondor Shipyards|raid]] on the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]], the survivors were assigned to a [[Rebel base (Cardooine)|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cardooine/Legends|Cardooine]]. They were given prototype [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] to fly. After a week, the base came [[Assault on Cardooine|under attack]] by Imperial forces, and although the Dactillions demonstrated the superb qualities of the A-wing, only two [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], including Artha, survived the battle.<ref name="Zal" /> During the battle they were assisted by the [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Tendaar Bel]], who scrambled the Imperials' IFF codes.<ref name="Tendaar">[[Takeover at Whisper Base (adventure)|''Takeover at Whisper Base (Adventure Book)'']] Tendaar Engineer Character Folio</ref> Artha then requested reassignment to [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]].<ref name="Zal" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Soaring Dactillions squadron was mentioned in Zal Artha's Character Folio included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.
